source.summary: GitHub Actions ‘Embedder footprint’ runs for PR #339 (branch fix/192-shared-lowering at head 3baa5ab2ed17f394be3e940bce2478952353ef82 — the #192 change (the three baseline JIT backends merged into one shared lowering over a per-target BaselineMasm trait, plus the Codex P1 fix mapping the inverted condition through cond_code in AArch64 cset_w; commits 8b94d2e, 8b34d6c, 54553ad, 97bba04, ea36972 and 3baa5ab) merged with current main 7db0701fdf188885150683e531fd6a246235d55d (PRs #329, #336, #337 and #338); ubuntu-24.04, Rust 1.96.0): workflow_dispatch runs 45549109565, 45549132836 and 45549156346 against the branch and pull-request run 45549088433, which built the same tree, produced byte-identical sizes for every gated series
source.derivation: Re-baseline for PR #339 (#192, the three baseline JIT backends (x86_64, aarch64, riscv64) merged into one shared lowering generic over a per-target BaselineMasm trait; the branch also carries the Codex P1 fix for that lowering: AArch64 cset_w emitted the inverted condition from the shared semantic Cond discriminant instead of the target encoding, fixed by mapping through cond_code). The branch merged main twice during integration (726fdd9, then 7db0701 after PRs #336 and #338 landed); the recorded values come from the second measurement round, on the branch merged with main at 7db0701fdf188885150683e531fd6a246235d55d. Attribution was isolated by measuring current main alone three times (workflow_dispatch runs 45549096511, 45549121384 and 45549145537 on main at 7db0701fdf188885150683e531fd6a246235d55d; all three runs pass the gate). The main control reproduces the checked-in baseline exactly on all 32 gated series, so no part of the gate failure is main-side staleness. This PR's own delta against the main control is confined to core-jit, the only embedder configuration that links the JIT backends: in release, stripped file +576 B and stripped .text +384 B; in release-size, stripped file -64 B and stripped .text +112 B. Every other configuration is byte-identical to main in both profiles. The delta is identical to the first measurement round against main at 726fdd9 (branch runs 45545862796, 45545874933, 45546994821 and pull-request run 45545862499; main control 45541261935, 45541270512, 45541278948), in which the pull-request run measured the three component configurations 848 to 2,344 B lower than every other sample; in the second round all four branch samples agree byte-for-byte on every series. Run-to-run spread was 0 B for every gated series across the four branch samples and across the three main samples. Against the original #164 baseline, the largest cumulative growth is now the release component stripped file series at +9.96% (2,433,656 B to 2,675,928 B), raised by PR #338's landing and not changed by this PR; the release core-nosimd stripped file series stays at +9.83% (1,275,448 B to 1,400,840 B). The core-aot configuration, added by PR #267 after the #164 baseline, is not part of the cumulative comparison.
